tags.feature: Three Legendary Belts have been added.
Belt of Reprieve: Gains +0.1 to 0.15 seconds of invulnerability after taking damage.

Belt of Tenacity: When your health reaches 0, you resist death once, recover 10-60% of your Maximum Life, and become invulnerable for 2 seconds. When equipped with the Legendary Amulet Stigma of Resolve, you can resist death up to 2 times.
Belt of Resonance: When casting an Assistant Skill, increase All Skill Damage by 20-50% for 5 seconds.

tags.bug: Item Name Duplication Fixed (“Guardians of Eternity”)
Fixed an issue where Mythic Armor and Legendary Amulets had the same name.
The name of the Legendary Amulet has been changed to “Stigma of Resolve.”
Mythic Belt “[b]Lion's Belt[/b]” Drop and Crafting Bug Fixed
Fixed an issue where the item could not be acquired in the game.
Item Effect: When your health drops below 40%, you will recover all health and create a barrier equal to 50-100% of your Maximum Life. The barrier lasts for 8 seconds. (Cooldown: 60 seconds)
Mythic Armor “Guardians of Eternity” Barrier Effect Bug Fixed
Fixed an issue where the Barrier value would reset when you unequipped/re-equipped gear after using a Barrier skill.
Fixed an issue where the Upgrade effect would disappear when the Barrier skill ended.
Improved the overall Barrier system
Fixed an issue where the Barrier value would display incorrectly or function abnormally.
Fixed a bug where you could infinitely restore your Barrier by repeatedly equipping/unequipping gear.
[b]Fixed an issue where Mythic grade gear buffs were not applied.[/b]
Fixed an issue where Mythic grade gear stats were not reflected in some situations.

tags.balance_change: Mythic grade [b]Blade of the Storm[/b] option changed
All Basic skills level increased by 3-5.
Attack Speed increased by 10%-20%.
Consumes 10 Combat Resources when using Basic Skills, and when Combat Resources are 10 or higher, Basic Skill Damage is increased by 200-300%.

tags.feature: Added Jump Cancellation to Basic Skills
Pressing the Jump key while using a Basic Skill will immediately cancel the skill and allow you to jump.
Improved Range Display in Other Languages
Previously, stats ranges were only supported in Korean and English, but now they are displayed naturally in other languages as well.
Added Controller Button Remapping
You can freely change the controller controls in the options screen.

notes.title: 1.0 Official Release
notes.content:
Hello, this is Team Suneat.

It has been a year since the early access release in 2024, and we are now ready to release version 1.0 officially.

During the Early Access period, we received extensive feedback, which led to significant changes, including a core system overhaul, improved art quality, and UI/UX enhancements. We removed unreasonable elements, adjusted the game to make it more accessible to new players, and maintained the depth that will challenge experienced players through extensive testing and experimentation.

We have now completed the [b]1.0[/b] update with these improvements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/ac520a8762debd0746de6310c3c3ea54c4af63fc.gif[/img]

[h2]1.0 Specifications[/h2]


[h3]New Playable Character[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/098e6e2ee6b41816d13507927ebc720f5995e565.gif[/img]
She is a female hunter known as the “Beast Hunter.”
She uses a throwing spear and throwing daggers. She also utilizes the abilities of various beasts to fight in unique ways.

[h3]Final Story Chapter and Final Boss[/h3]
  The truth hidden beyond the dragon is revealed.[list]
[*] The final chapter has been added.
[*] Three new boss battles, including the final boss, have been added.
[/list]

[h3]Difficulty Customization System[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/e093850cfd65cc5da43e3a2a4e4bf406175b600c.png[/img]
Players can set the difficulty level to their preferred settings. Up to 15 levels are available.
By default, when switching to Nightmare difficulty from the adventure, enemy attack power increases by 200% and health by 200%.
After each stage, enemy attack power increases by 50% and health by 100%, and the following effects are applied simultaneously. 
[list]
[*]Environmental Threats (Up to 3 Stages)
[list][*]Stage 1: Nightmare Stone - A Nightmare Stone falls at the player's location every 7 seconds, dealing 150 fixed damage.[/list][list][*]Stage 2: Venomous Pool - A Venomous Pool is generated at the player's location every 7 seconds, dealing 50 fixed damage per second.[/list][list][*]Stage 3: Aura of Fury - All bosses enter Berserker mode (attack power increases by 50% each time the boss's remaining health drops to 75/50/25%)[/list][*]Player Weakening (Maximum 4 stages)
[list][*]Stage 1: All resistances "-10%"
[*]Stage 2: All resistances "-20%"
[*]Stage 3: All resistances "-30%"
[*]Stage 4: All resistances "-40%"[/list][*]Additional Elite Skill (Maximum 4 stages)
[list][*]Stage 1: Resurrecting Skeletons - Continuously summons skeletons (1 every 5 seconds, maximum 30)
[*]Stage 2: Dark Flames - Elites possess dark orbs that rotate around them. Colliding with a dark orb deals 50% of the Elite's attack power as damage and reduces attack power by 50% for 5 seconds
[*]Stage 3: Blitz Orb - Elites possess a relatively large lightning orb on their back. The Blitz Orb fires a lightning bolt toward the player every n seconds. The lightning bolt deals 80% of the Elite's attack power as damage and stuns the player for 2 seconds.
[*]Stage 4: Prison of Thorns - The Elite creates a Prison of Thorns area under the player's feet every n seconds. The Prison of Thorns deals 40% of the Elite's attack power as damage and inflicts 20% bleeding damage per second for 3 seconds.[/list][*]Additional Boss Patterns (Up to Stage 4)
[list]
[*]Stage 1: Longmore Pattern Added
[*]Stage 2: Tormentor Pattern Added
[*]Stage 3: Vargas Pattern Added
[*]Stage 4: Buchalu Pattern Added
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Maximum Equipment Level Expansion[/h3]
[list][*]Nightmare difficulty increases the maximum drop equipment level by 2 for every +1 stage.
[*]However, the maximum shop level is unlocked upon clearing the final boss, Triple Ashat.
[/list]

[h3]New “Mythic” Equipment Grade[/h3]

[h3]New Blacksmith Hank's Feature[/h3][list]

[list]

[*]Overwhelming activates with a 50% chance when hitting an enemy while under a shield. The damage dealt by Overwhelming increases by the same percentage as the enemy's defense reduction.
[*]You can increase the damage of Overwhelming with the Transcendence Ember feature.[/list]

[h3]Future Plans[/h3]
Updates will continue after 1.0.[list]
[*] [b]Add Legendary Equipment[/b]
[*] [b]Artifact Balancing[/b][/list]
While preparing for the official release, we have worked hard to improve the quality of “The Dragon is Dead” by reflecting on the feedback and lessons learned during the early access period. Of course, we are aware that there are still challenges and issues to address. We plan to continue refining aspects such as build balance, appropriate distribution of legendary equipment across new difficulty tiers, and the meaningful scope of certain NPC quests and feature unlocks.

We hope the new systems and regions we will introduce in Version 1.0 will bring you great satisfaction.

We appreciate your continued interest and feedback on “The Dragon is Dead,” and our team will continue to strive to provide players with a deep sense of immersion through the joy of action, farming, and building. 

[b]Thank you.[/b]

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that we will be fully launching on June 6th! Less than a month from now!
In the 1.0 release, you can expect:

We will be introducing a climactic final region and boss, the feral new heroine “Hunter of the Beast,” fully customizable difficulty options, and an overhauled Quenching system that enables high-risk, high-reward builds.

What's New in 1.0?
[list]
[*] Final Region & Boss Battle : In the climactic final chapter, the remaining members of the Guernian clan become entangled with the schemes of the Circle of the Dawn, forcing players to confront the ultimate truth behind the dragon's demise. 
[*] New Enemies: Beware the Circle of the Black Dawn, fanatical human worshippers who seized Guernian's heart after his death. Led by the ambitious Ashat, they seek to expand their power and dominate the world. 
[*] Legendary and Mythic Gear : Discover a wealth of new Legendary gear and a brand new  and more powerful Mythic tier of equipment, boasting unprecedented effects to enhance your builds. 
[*] Item Quenching: Introducing the ability to quench your equipment! This new system allows players to add new options to their gear and further upgrade the performance of existing ones, adding a new layer of customization. 
[*] New Hero: The Hunter: A feral -new playable character, the Hunter, joins the fray, bringing unique skills and combat style to the battlefield. 
[*] Nightmare More x15 : For seasoned adventurers seeking the ultimate test, 15 levels of challenging Nightmare difficulty will unlock after completing the base game. These endgame challenges feature entirely new enemy patterns and systems, not just increased enemy numbers.
[/list]

Check out the release date trailer!

[*] (Before modification) Equipment option: For each enemy that is taking damage, the damage you deal to the enemy increases by (5-7%), and the damage you receive decreases by 4%.
[*] (After the update) Equipment options: Damage dealt to enemies increases by (5-7%) for each Damage Over Time effect the enemy is receiving, and damage received from enemies decreases by 4%.

[*] Fixed so that the effect of the Legendary Equipment [Clara's Hood] is displayed on the HUD.

[*] Fixed a bug where the Legendary equipment [Blade of Frost] was applied when casting the Spell Blade's core skill [Frost Arrow], regardless of whether it was equipped.
[*] Spell Blade's Core Skill [Lightning Frenzy] Fixed a bug that gave a 15% chance to deal Lightning Frenzy damage instead of Lightning Strike when cast.
[*] Legendary Equipment [Vandevius's Boots] Fixed a bug that made the icon look blurry.
[*] Fixed a bug where resources were not filled to the maximum when activating the effect of the legendary equipment [Pendant of Vital Bliss].
[*] Fixed a bug where there was a 65% chance that the legendary equipment [Lightning Frenzy] would deal one more hit with the Lightning Thorns instead of the Frost Pulse.
[*] Fixed a bug where the VFX was not generated when casting the [Sword of Fire] skill in mid-air while wearing the [Dancing Flame] legendary equipment.
[*] Fixed a bug where combat resources were obtained when using the [Frenzy Strike] skill while wearing the [Swift Slaughterer] legendary equipment.
[*] Fixed the Legendary Equipment [Thorn of Agony] so that the Stunned effect also applies to the skill [Frantic Whirlwind] when it hits.

First, I'd like to sincerely apologize for not delivering the content that was scheduled to be updated in Q4 2024. 

[h3][b]With that in mind, I'd like to update you on the progress of our current work.[/b][/h3]

The final chapter is a crucial turning point in the story, where key secrets of the game are revealed and the story of the final boss, Ashat, is told in depth. However, we've decided that the current state of the work is not up to our expectations and quality standards.
We've decided to scrap the existing deliverable and rework it anew. We sincerely apologize for any delays in this process, and we'll do our best to deliver a more complete experience.

[h3][b]We have much more content in the works, not just the battles in the final chapter.[/b][/h3]

In addition to the final chapter, we're preparing the following new content to make your experience even more exciting:

[list]
[*] [b]Nightmare Difficulty Improvements[/b]: not just increasing the numbers, we're providing new challenging content that allows you to customize the difficulty on your terms.
[*] New Legendary Gear: uniquely themed gear for new strategies and styles.
[*] New Tiered Gear: Mythic gear that's even more powerful than Legendary.
[*] New Character: introduce a new character, "Hunter," with skills and playstyles that are different from existing characters.
[*] Quenching: You'll be able to change the options on your gear to your liking and strengthen your favorite options.
[/list]
All of the above content is systemically connected, and we plan to finalize it and unveil it at the official launch.

[h3][b]Changes to the official launch schedule[/b][/h3]
In order to deliver better quality, we are rescheduling the official launch from Q1 2025 to [b]May 2025.[/b]
Until the official launch, we will continue to provide balance tweaks and bug-fix patches to maintain a stable play experience.

[h3][b]Update Preview[/b][/h3]
Here are the highlights of the content that will be added at launch:

[h2][b]1. New Region and Final Chapter[/b][/h2]
In the final chapter, the remnants of the Guernian clan intertwine with the plans of the Circle of the Dawn, forcing players to face the ultimate truth.

The Circle of the Black Dawn are the human worshippers of Guernian, who monopolized his heart after his death. With Ashat as their leader, they harbor ambitions to increase their power and rule the world.

notes.title: Updated 0.7311 - Aerial Skills and Balance Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Motion Delay Improvements and Aerial Skill Use Update[/h2]

In this update, we've improved the characters' motion lag, which is important to the game's control and difficulty experience, and made it possible to use skills in the air.
"Dragon is Dead" is a hack-and-slash genre where fast-paced, immersive combat and lag-free skill use are vital. With this update, we're bringing the combat experience closer to the core of hack-and-slash, making the game feel smoother and the combat flow more fluid.

With aerial skills now allowed, players have more freedom to utilize space to attack and can use them whenever they want. We've also adjusted the pre- and post-delay of all abilities to make them feel more comfortable and keep combat flowing smoothly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/22f822e046c6db6b8870a898d050023382bfc61e.gif[/img]

On the balance front, we've addressed the boredom that can be caused by the high health of enemies in the early game and the ease with which enemies can be defeated in the later game when they can't be strong enough with your progression. We've lowered the health of early-game bosses, increased the health of later-game bosses, and reduced the health of common enemies. We've increased the maximum amount of optional stats that can be granted from equipment to make it easier for you to develop your character in the direction you want.

We've also increased the reroll rate of Andes Synergy +1 encountered early in the game to make it easier to build Synergy.
Legendary gear is an important part of the game, and we've taken several steps to make it more accessible to players, including adding rarity to gear sold in the Shop and making Legendary gear dropable from in-game chests.

[b]Here are the key points of this update.[/b]

[h3][Using skills while jumping][/h3]
[list]
[*] All Spell Blade skills can be used while jumping.
[*] All Berserker skill can be used while jumping.
[/list]
[h3][Improved skill cast delay][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved motion delays and skill canceling on all Spell Blade core skills.
[*] Improved motion delay and skill canceling on all Spell Blade mastery skills.
[*] Improved motion delay and skill canceling on all Spell Blade's ultimate skills.
[*] Improved attack speed and motion delay on all weapon-specific basic skills for Spell Blade.
[*] Improved motion delay and skill canceling on all Berserker core skills.
[*] Improved motion delay and skill canceling on all Berserker mastery skills.
[*] Improved motion delay and skill canceling on all Berserker ultimates.
[*] Improved attack speed and motion delay of all Berserker's weapon-specific basic skills.
[/list]
[h3][Fixed equipment maximum option value][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]All DamageRate increased: 15% max → 30% max[/b]
[list]
[*] Physical
[*] Cold
[*] Fire
[*] Lightning
[/list]
[*][b]Skill damage increased: +1% max per gear level → +2% per gear level[/b]
[list]
[*] Basic
[*] Core
[*] Mastery
[*] Ultimate
[*] Assistant
[/list][*] All Magic Damage Rate increased: 10% max → 20% max
[*] Attack Speed increased: 10% max → 15% max
[*] Critical Chance Chance increased: 4.5% max → 6% max
[*] Critical Damage increased: up to 30% → up to 60%
[*] Life increased: up to +20 → up to 50
[*] Damage reduction increased: +3% to +5% max
[*] Skill resource cost reduced: -5% max → -10% max
[*] Skill cooldown time reduction: up to 5% reduction → up to 15% reduction
[*] Increased gold drop chance: up to 20% → up to 30%
[*] Increased experience gained: up to 20% → up to 30%
[/list]
[h3][Sounds][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some sounds that were not working properly or were being amplified.
[/list]
[h3][Balance][/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the health of common enemies.
[*] Boss longmore health has been reduced.
[*] Boss Tormentor, Buchalu, Morr, and Rilmozorg health has been increased.
[*] Legendary gear can now be dropped from regular chests in stages.
[*] Significantly increased the chance of dropping legendaries from boss cores and ruby chests.
[*] Increased the chance to drop Legendaries from Bertio's shop.
[*] Granders and Lippa will now sell rare gear.
[*] [Artifact] Life Blood Pouch's health restoration amount has been changed: 50 → 15
[*] [Artifact] Bell of Silence health bonus value has been changed: (100% → 50%)
[*] [Essence] Cloak Of Life resource reduction value has been changed. (30 → 15%)
[*] [Essence] Changed the spawn location of the Lion Scapular (Temple of Light → Parched Elemental Forest)
[*] [Legendary Armor] Hands of Blinding Speed attack speed duration: 1-3 seconds → 3-7 seconds
[*] [Legendary Armor] Molten Hydra Armor Maximum Hydra Spawned: 5 → 15
[*] Spell Blade Lightning Sphere Max Spawn : 3 → 7
[*] Andes Synergy reroll: 1 → 5 times
[*] Bertio's first appearance requirement changed from 2 deaths to 1 death.
[*] Increased the number of magic stones dropped by enemies.
[*][b]Added/modified the effects of [Artifact Synergy] Surveillance.[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased thorn damage was added to the first effect.
[*] Increased thorn damage (%) was added to the second effect.
[*] Removed the cooldown condition from the third effect and added a fixed Mastery/Ultimate Skill damage increase.
[/list][/list]
[h3][Convenience][/h3]
[list]
[*] Bosses "Vargas" and "Mor" no longer have dialogue from the second encounter.
[/list]
[h3][Warehouse][/h3]
[b]Added the ability to expand the Warehouse using magic stones.[/b]
[list]
[*] Tab 2: 5,000 magic stones
[*] Tap 3: 50,000 magic stones
[*] Tap 4: 100,000 magic stones
[/list]
[h3][New Legendary Gear][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Morr's Battle Boots[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/de082d528754dd31631bfb9349f6e616ae44ed6c.png[/img]
[b]Dash[/b] can be used once more in a row and reduces the resource cost of your core skills by 15-30% for 1-3 seconds after casting dash.
[*][b]Necklace of Destiny's Crystal [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/e1521c36fa0aed1517d821f92a6acb02506d3d29.png[/img]
Increases one of your stats by 3-5 when you level up: Strength, Dexterity, or Intelligence.
[/list]
[h3][Bug Fix][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the resolution would not change.
[*] Fixed a bug where resolution and audio volume could not be set when attempting to modify game options via the pause window
[/list]
With this update, we've focused on maximizing the immersion and sense of accomplishment you'll feel in battle, and we'll continue to make improvements to bring you an even better gaming experience.

Stay tuned for our next announcement, which will bring you to
[list]
[*] The Final Chapter
[*] Mythic Tier Gear
[*] Adjusting the Nightmare Difficulties up to Level 15
[*] Final Boss
[/list]
As always, thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: New Legendaries! v0.71 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've posted a major update to version 0.7101, it adds additional legendary items and artifacts, in addition to some balancing and bug fixes. Please see the details below:

[h3] New Legendary Equipment [/h3]
[b]Molten Hydra Armor[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/64a9b55b4a9ede2ac47b9d1b4508482a7b88c95b.gif[/img]
[*]Hitting an enemy with a Basic or Mastery skill has a 7% chance to summon a Molten Hydra for 7 seconds. 
[*]The Hydra fires a fireball at nearby enemies for 150-800% Attack Damage (max 5).
[/list]
[b]Ring of Red Spirit[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/c4ea7de9293614a30725059c73fff60f6bc8674c.gif[/img]
[*]Hitting an enemy with basic skill increases critical damage of core skill by 10% for 5 sec (Stacks up to 5-10)
[/list]
[b]Ruthless Cycling[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/5f097d22eaab6b7393a6afb7ca54dbb384605df2.gif[/img]
[*]Hitting a skill has a 10-20% chance to reduce all skill cooldowns by 1 second.
[/list]
[b]Volcanic Sword (SpellBlade only)[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/0bfb56c57fd3ee07ec15df24cdf32c2c67250603.gif[/img]
[*]A ball of flame bounces up to 1-3 times, dealing 50% less damage per bounce. An explosion occurs if no enemies are nearby based on the number of bounces remaining.
[/list]
[b]Swift Slaughterer (Berserker only)[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/57a253bd13f77f39595c558852762ac4bb5421b2.gif[/img]
[*]Changes Frenzy Strike to a continuous attack with no delay and no longer charges madness on hit. Increases basic skill damage by 100-150%, and the Frenzy Strike buff has a maximum stack of 9.
[/list]
[h3] New Artifact [/h3]
[b]Contractor's Hourglass (Magic)[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/a07a0f737ed463afb89c394f1094dc77fcf64cfa.png[/img]
[*]Increases damage dealt to enemies by 50%.
[*]Increases maximum health by 50%.
[*]You will be granted 120 sec to defeat the boss, or die
[/list]
[h3] Changes to Artifacts [/h3]
[list]
[*]Anguish : Final gold gain reduction 90% → 99%
[*]Corroded Axe Blade : Deals Physical Damage → Deals Damage
[*]Warrior’s Drum : Deals Physical Damage → Deals Damage
[*]Crimson Cactus : Deals Physical Damage → Deals Damage
[*]Dragon's Elixir : every time you deal Physical Damage → every time you deal Damage
[*]Merciless Destroyer : Physical Damage has a chance to Critically Hit → Damage has a chance to Critically Hit
[*]Wolf's Torn Jaw : Physical Damage → Damage
[*]Fragment of Resentment : Physical Damage dealt → Damage dealt
[*]Cloak of the Wolf : Deals increased Physical Damage → Deals 30% increased Damage to Enemies
[*]Seal of the Black Wolf : Deals Physical Damage → Deals Damage / Physical Damage Amplified → Damage Amplified
[*]Wolf’s Head Ornament : Whenever you take Physical Damage → Whenever you take Damage / Increase Physical Damage dealt to enemies → Increase Damage dealt to enemies
[/list]
[h3] Balancing [/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased Legendary chance from Bertio gear purchases, Ruby Chests, and Boss Core
[*]Endless Will (Legendary Artifact) cooldown reduction corrected: 5 seconds → 1 second
[*]Synergy Skill 3-Set Dash cooldown reduction: 0.5s → 0.3s
[*]Berserker Madness Wave animation delay reduction
[*]Berserker Frantic Chain attack speed increased
[*]Berserker Roar animation speed increased
[*]Berserker Bloody Berserk animation speed increased
[/list]
[h3] Bug fixes [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed equipment being sold while equipped
[*]Fixed Berserker's weapon attack speed was stacked twice
[*]Fixed a bug where purchasing a new gear from Bertio would replace the currently equipped gear
[*]Fixed Bertio's belt purchase being incorrect
[*]Fixed an issue with using Shaman skill reset after equipping Throwing Hammer of Thunderbolt
[*]Fixed some enemies in the Temple of Light being unable to attack
[*]Fixed a bug where the Legendary Gear Dancing Frame ground attack would generate stacked FX
[*]Fixed a bug where the Legendary Gear Dancing Frame's aerial attack would not go out
[*]You can now see the range of options for Legendary items when you enable Show Item Option Range in the game's Accessibility settings.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the 7-set effect of Artifact Synergy [Merchant] from triggering
[*]Fixed a bug where the SpellBlade's Mastery skill [Lightning Sphere] would spawn more than 3, contrary to the description that it can spawn up to 3
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback for Dragon is Dead, we continue to work on new content and improvements.

Team Suneat

notes.title: Upcoming Game System Changes & Updates
notes.content:
[h2][Unify Attack Power][/h2]

In Dragon is Dead, the DEV team wants our players to be able to freely mix and match their progression and experiment with it.
We felt that the current two separate ways of applying damage conflicted with this direction.
So, we're unifying physical and magical damage into damage, which will require us to re-plan and revise all of the components involved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/d4eaef1d530b40d128877e75a735a2e6ce5e2aca.gif[/img]

[b]Specs under modification[/b]
[list]
[*] Basic stats: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Vitality
[*] Elixir
[*] Food
[*] Artifact
[*] Synergy
[/list]

[h2][Polishing Spellblade's Attack Motion][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/bd2de3862345c3dbccf22916fab0fae2a940b425.gif[/img]

[h2][Adding Basic Attack Motion For Each Weapon Type][/h2]

We are planning to apply unique motions for basic attacks by weapon type.
[b]Sword, Blunt, Axe, Dagger[/b]
(Example) Spellblade's dagger motion
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/478ddd8c3146c83c3029dc7f3cbe0c9a24635f4e.gif[/img]

[h2][Regarding flying monsters and unavailability of skill use in the air][/h2]

Some of the most negative feedback is that flying monsters are difficult to kill without using skills in the air. To address this, we are working on several legendary pieces of equipment and artifacts that can be used to deal efficiently with aerial monsters.
For example, legendary equipment that generates guided projectiles and converts core skills into aerial skills, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/8f3f0d2ad6aaae2325043129b8fa8709d25944be.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/8fb1b7abe6728da37605619f0c4bd83c5129ba8f.gif[/img]

[h2][Skill balance][/h2]
We recognize the issue of specific skills being overpowered by legendary gear. However, we do not believe that simple numerical balancing alone will solve this issue. We're addressing this by adding fun new Legendary gear that increases the power of skills that are currently underpowered or don't have Legendary gear, in addition to numerical balancing. We'll continue to add fun new Legendary gear on a weekly basis as we get major bugs and system cleanup underway.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/0e36da739baf0286a5f09c032351b1fb037c8bac.gif[/img]

[h2][More spots for legendary gear drop][/h2]
[list]
[*] We're adding more ways to drop Legendary gear.
[*] Bosses will have a chance to drop an additional Legendary Gear from the Red Orb they drop.
[*] Bertio has a chance to drop Legendary gear when you gamble.
[*] Ruby Chests have a chance to drop Legendary gear.
[/list]

[h2][Expanding warehouse][/h2]
We will be making it possible to expand the Warehouse using Magic Stones
[h2]
[Adding a new currency Soul Shard][/h2]
[list]
[*] We'll add a new currency called Soul Shard.
[*] The new currency (Soul Shard) can be obtained by defeating bosses.
[*] Added a Grinder to Hank's Forge in Cliffshire that can salvage Legendary Equipment.
[*] Salvaging Legendary Equipment will give you Soul Shards
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/63a64fd596c52c92339b9a78ff10b52afdfef2fb.png[/img]
The number of Soul Shards dropped will be higher with greater difficulties and for late-stage bosses.

[h2][Changes to Legendary Equipment][/h2]
To craft Legendary Gear, you must obtain it at least once to unlock the blueprint.
[list]
[*] All blueprints for Legendary gear you already own will remain unlocked.
[*]  You will need to reacquire Legendary gear that you previously owned but sold and is no longer in your Warehouse or inventory.
[*] Burning Heart now requires Soul Shard to craft Legendary Gear.
[*] Increased the amount of Magic Stones required to craft Legendary Gear (1,500 → 5,000)
[/list]

[h2][Legendary Weapon Synergy Stat][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/96f6f96d9ffdccb4258b8a51f0d6a737e8592465.gif[/img]
Legendary Gear (Weapons) will have a chance to grant +1 random Synergy when acquired and crafted.
[list]
[*] 10% chance to be granted
[/list]

[h2][Upcoming Legendary Gear][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/45dbcb8ab3de4120a1accd9c6a29b5df3a0f7c0b.gif[/img]

[b]Thunderbolt Throwing Hammer for Spellblade only[/b]
[list]
[*] Change your Sword of Lightning skill to a Hammer Throwing ranged skill. The hammer bounces off the first enemy it hits up to 5 times for 100-200% attack damage. Damage is reduced by 10% per bounce.
[/list]
[b]Warden of Electrocution for Spellblade only[/b]
[list]
[*] Whenever an enemy suffers shock damage, a chain of lightning strikes 5 nearby enemies for 100-150% damage.
[/list]
[b]Hands of Blinding Speed for common use[/b]
[list]
[*] Hitting an enemy with Basic Skills increases your Attack Speed by 5% for 1-3 seconds, up to 20%.
[/list]

These changes will be updated over time. Thank you for your continued support of Dragon's Dead and may you always walk in the light!

notes.title: Game Feedback & Update Plans!
notes.content:
Since opening Early Access, we've received a lot of feedback. We're currently prioritizing adding basic systems (such as changing keyboard keys) and fixing bugs that interrupt the game's
immersion. [b]We are aiming for key remapping to be delivered on 6/18.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/a9a6b54c1e04e6501ca2f2479a51fe9ce8b9fdfc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Adjusting difficulty and adding a mid-boss[/h2]

We recognize that the difficulty curve in the early game is steep. Dragon is Dead is all about hack-
and-slash combat and using a variety of legendary gear. We want the acquisition and use of Legendary Gear to be an incentive to replay and the experience to be new and enjoyable each
time. We're aware that the path to your first Legendary Gear isn't currently working as intended, and we'll be addressing this. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/ab04e3272c4d501abbb7468b22872231c8be307c.png[/img]

[h2]Fixing bugs and adding new content[/h2]
Once we're mostly done with the bug fixes, we'll move forward with our announced major update,
adding new Legendary gear every week.

[h2]Major Q3 Update[/h2]

The major update for Q3 is a new town-building system that rewards gameplay time, naturally
leading to early growth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911761/50afb126fad503d8222d898f4c6307c85c538f1e.png[/img]

[h2]Looking ahead and saying thank you[/h2]
We recognize that our game currently needs to improve in many ways. We'll continue to gather
your feedback and make improvements to make the game even more fun. We've republished a
new milestone reflecting some changes from the previous one. Please check them out. Thank you
to everyone who plays the game.
